tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL TERMS AND CONDITIONS AS PER TENDER DOCUMENT

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Provide details of experience in delivering human resource services to Government departments, Government institutions, and corporations. The firm must have a minimum of 5 years experience, with at least 3 years of supplying minimum of 50 outsource manpower annually.

Details of human resource services provided during the current years 2023-24,2024-25 and 2025-26 must be submitted along with copies of relevant work orders and Satisfaction work done Certificate obtained from the Govt Authorities
A valid Firm Establishment Certificate must be submitted and the license shall remain valid for the financialyear2026-27
Certificate issued by Labor Department (FORM C) Which is having Provision of Obtaining Maximum of 50 Human Resources

GST Registration Certificate and GST Challans of 2023-24,2025-26,2026-27to be submitted. Additionally also provide GST R-1 and GST R-3B returns for the same periods and transactions must be related to outsourcing services Only.
Provide a notarized affidavit on Rs.100 stamp paper affirming that the firm is not blacklisted, Notary issued after the date of the tender notification refer to this tender notification only.
Must submit ISO 9001:2015Quality certificate and Must submit Private Security Agency (Regulation) Act 2005 & Private Security Agency Rules 2008 Certificate.

If the organization/agency is found to be balance in arrears of EPF and ESI contributions or is subject to any inquiry or recovery proceedings, their tender shall not be considered at any stage. In this regard, a notarized affidavit on Rs.100/- stamp paper must be submitted in the name of CEO ZP Uttara Kannada, Karwar.

If the Outsource Manpower Service organization/agency was blacklisted by any department, such organizations cannot participate in the tender process, or if there are cases in the courts/departmental appellate authorities regarding the functioning of the agencies/organization, it is mandatory to inform in writing about the stage of inquiry. In this regard, a self-declaration certificate should be issued by the organization/agency on their letterhead.

An agreement certificate on Rs.100/- stamp paper must be furnished confirming that the organization/agency that they will establish an office in Uttara Kannada district if they get Office order about said tender

A notarized affidavit on Rs.100/- stamp paper must be submit declaring that life and accident insurance will be provided to all the outsourced personnel's within 30 days from the date of receipt of the supply order/office order
EPF Registration Certificate must be provided, along with month wise challan copies for FY 2025-26
ESI Registration Certificate must be provided, along with month wise challan copies for FY 2025-26
Professional Tax Registration Certificate must be provided, along along with Clearance challan copies for FY 2025-26

PAN card details must be provided, along with Income Tax Returns for the financial years 2023-24,2024-25 and 2025-26Certified copies of Form 3CB and Form 3CD, along with the filed ITR copies clearly mentioning the PAN, should also be submitted

Provide a solvency certificate from a nationalized bank covering 30% of the tender amount put to tender duly addressed to the Chief Executive Officer, Zilla Panchayat Uttar Kannada, Karwar. Solvency Certificate must be obtained after the Tender notification date and refer to this tender only.

Annual turnover details for the financial years2023-24,2024-25 and 2025-26must be provided, Attach audited reports in Form 3CB and Form 3CD duly certified by a Chartered Accountant. If the annual Turnover is more than 100 lakhs online returns details must be Submitted.
